extraction_metadata.notes: Reverse-engineered from arXiv:2602.03320 (Feb 2026). Extends MedSAM with multi-modal LLM agent loop for interactive medical image segmentation.

title: MedSAM-Agent: Empowering Interactive Medical Image Segmentation with Multi-modal Large Language Models
subtitle_or_tagline: Generalizable medical segmentation via multi-modal LLM agent
topic: MedSAM-Agent evolves medical image segmentation from task-specific models toward generalizable frameworks. The system augments MedSAM with a multi-modal Large Language Model that interprets user prompts and image context to produce segmentation masks across diverse medical imaging tasks. The agent loop enables interactive refinement and natural-language-driven segmentation.

components.name: Multi-modal LLM
components.role: Interprets user intent + image content, plans segmentation strategy

components.name: MedSAM image encoder
components.role: Extracts visual features from the medical image

components.name: Prompt encoder
components.role: Encodes user-provided prompts (text, box, point, mask)

components.name: Mask decoder
components.role: Combines image and prompt features to predict segmentation mask

components.name: Agent loop
components.role: Iterative refinement: LLM reviews mask, suggests prompt revisions

architecture.data_flow: User natural-language prompt + medical image -> multi-modal LLM interprets intent -> MedSAM predicts mask -> LLM reviews -> refines prompt if needed -> final mask

workflow_steps: Step 1 - User provides image and natural-language request.
Step 2 - Multi-modal LLM interprets intent and translates into MedSAM prompts.
Step 3 - MedSAM produces initial segmentation mask.
Step 4 - LLM reviews mask against image and intent.
Step 5 - If unsatisfactory, LLM proposes refined prompts and re-runs MedSAM.
key_claims: Generalizable framework: single system handles diverse medical segmentation tasks.
Multi-modal LLM enables natural-language interaction with non-expert users.
Agent loop improves accuracy through iterative refinement.
Built on MedSAM, extending it from promptable to interactive.
caveats_or_warnings: No mathematical bound on segmentation accuracy; agent loop heuristics may produce inconsistent masks across runs.
Multi-modal LLM inference adds latency and cost per case.
Failure modes of LLM (hallucination, prompt sensitivity) propagate into segmentation outcomes.
